httpTransport.input: typed fetch Request and selected io.fetch injection
rules: helper ABI distinct from business Entry ABI
shared helper reuse does not grant access

entry.input: checked Entry request and original Auth owner context

work.input: original workflow stage with durable work identity
rules: approval and business rejection prevent downstream effects

inference.input: typed authorized bounded context and result schema

agent.input: bounded goal, original permitted Query tools and context
agent.owner: selected ARE harness plus outer business workflow
rules: no mutable tool grants minted by model

documents.input: owned source bytes, version, ACL revision and parse contract

rules: all context dependencies retained, including uncited sources

crm.input: contact-upsert-inspect/v1 command with original approval/manifest/effect identity
crm.completion: provider object inspection matching original command
rules: same account and correlation identity on inspection
unknown write has no automatic repeat/failover

ticket.input: approved reply/update with expected provider revision and recipient scope
rules: no blind repeat of unknown comments

campaign.input: approved campaign and current preference/recipient snapshot

accounting.input: approved draft-bill command and original attempt identity

messaging.input: versioned envelope, original event/command identity and resource binding
messaging.owner: selected broker adapter plus original inbox/outbox/effect owners
rules: effect commit precedes consumer ack when required

observations.owner: existing local observation owner or selected exporter
rules: sampled telemetry is not durable audit
post-commit export failure does not undo business success

webhook.input: exact bounded raw bytes plus verified provider/account signature and replay identity
webhook.completion: original durable inbox acceptance before response
webhook.owner: existing verified ingress owner plus original Entry/Auth owner
rules: broker identity never grants business permission

grpc.input: versioned protobuf request with declared unary/server/client/bidi mode
grpc.owner: candidate gRPC transport and original Entry/Auth owner
rules: stream backpressure and per-message authorization explicit
gRPC streaming is not durable event replay

audit.input: required business/security audit record under original transaction identity
rules: fail-closed policy explicit before effect where required
query capability distinct from structural storage ABI

voice.input: session media, consent and bounded conversation state

identityActions.owner: candidate identity mutation adapter plus original approval owner
rules: existing credential verification is not account provisioning
unknown grant/revoke never auto repeats through another provider

supplier.input: authorized catalogue/query or approved purchasing command

incident.input: authorized incident evidence or approved bounded response
rules: investigation read scope distinct from containment effects

codeHost.input: bounded repository/worktree request or approved change proposal
codeHost.owner: existing ARE boundary plus candidate code-host adapter
rules: patch generation is not merge authority

lab.input: owned goal/question/evidence/experiment records and bounded tool request
lab.completion: original Lab record and experiment identity
lab.owner: existing Lab owners; profile suite join remains planned
rules: no experiment side effects inferred from profile metadata

open_questions: These describe required design semantics; exact machine ABI/schema joins must be bound by each existing owner before executable generation.
